conversations.summary: Morning standup with the payments team

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Morning. Yesterday I finished the webhook signature check, it's merged.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Nice. The checkout service is still throwing 500s when the coupon code is empty.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Yeah that's a regression from my refactor. I'll fix the empty coupon crash today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus
utterances.text: I'm blocked on the staging database, the migration lock never released.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: I will pair with Marcus on the migration lock after this.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Cool. Let's go with Postgres advisory locks instead of the lock table going forward.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Did you watch the match last night?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Only the second half, the penalty was brutal.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Ha, I need to get groceries after work anyway.

conversations.summary: Pairing on the retry logic in the notifications worker

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: The notifications worker retries forever when the SMS provider times out.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Right, I'll add exponential backoff with a max of five attempts to the notifications worker.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: And the integration test for it is flaky on CI.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Let me quarantine the flaky integration test and open a ticket for it.

conversations.summary: Design review for the new audit log

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: We decided to store audit events in S3 with Athena on top, not in the main database.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: Makes sense. I can't ship the audit log UI until the events API is deployed.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Understood, I'll deploy the events API tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: And I need to write the runbook for rotating the webhook secret.
